detail.en-US: The study uses each report only after its announcement date, but the archived reports do not include every version investors saw at the time.
detail.zh-CN: 研究只在财报公告后使用其中的信息；但留存的财报不包含投资者当年看到的每一个版本。

detail.en-US: Version tracking began prospectively. Today’s downloads cannot recover the exact report versions available years ago.
detail.zh-CN: 财报版本从近期才开始持续留档；现在重新下载，无法找回多年前当时可见的原始版本。

detail.en-US: Checks cover the archived stock panel. They do not yet verify, for every past date, exactly which stocks were eligible across the whole market.
detail.zh-CN: 现有检查覆盖已归档的股票样本，但还没有逐日核实过去全市场究竟哪些股票符合纳入条件。

detail.en-US: Some held-stock prices are still missing, and the final value after a company exits the market has not been verified.
detail.zh-CN: 部分持仓股票仍缺价格；公司退出市场后的最终结算价值也尚未核实。

detail.en-US: After matching Beijing Stock Exchange suspension records by stock and date, 1 of the original monthly sequences has complete prices; 59 still have price gaps and 10 lack a month when the R&D-growth strategy could start. The strategy still cannot be validated as executable.
detail.zh-CN: 按股票和日期对齐北交所停牌记录后，原有月度序列中只有 1 条价格完整；59 条仍缺价格，另有 10 条缺少研发增长策略可开始建仓的月份。因此还不能确认策略能按设定执行。

detail.en-US: A fixed-fee calculation is only a sensitivity check. There is no evidence yet for actual fills, market impact or separately accounted dividend cash flows.
detail.zh-CN: 固定费率计算只是敏感性检查；目前没有真实成交、市场冲击或单独核算股息现金流的证据。

data_version.en-US: Separate historical execution follow-up reviewed 2026-10-03. It did not change the signal samples: 90/80 in the earlier run and 77/66 in the corrected run.
data_version.zh-CN: 这是 2026-10-03 复核的独立历史执行检查，没有改动信号样本：旧版为 90／80，修正版为 77／66。

missing.en-US: The record does not identify the exact original code revision, runner or complete input snapshot. A source link or file hash alone cannot prove that the full calculation can be reproduced.
missing.zh-CN: 记录没有标明当时完整的代码版本、运行环境和输入数据快照。只有来源链接或文件哈希，不能证明整套计算都能复现。

resume_when.en-US: Before treating this as a tradable portfolio, recover the missing prices and exit values and verify which stocks were eligible on each historical date. Keep the future test period sealed until its registered checks are ready.
resume_when.zh-CN: 要把结果用于真实组合之前，需要补齐缺失价格和退出结算，并核实每个历史日期哪些股票符合条件。未来检验期继续封存，等预先登记的检查条件满足后再看结果。

action.en-US: Before treating this as a tradable portfolio, recover the missing prices and exit values and verify which stocks were eligible on each historical date. Keep the future test period sealed until its registered checks are ready.
action.zh-CN: 要把结果用于真实组合之前，需要补齐缺失价格和退出结算，并核实每个历史日期哪些股票符合条件。未来检验期继续封存，等预先登记的检查条件满足后再看结果。

acceptance.en-US: Keep a dated, uneditable audit showing the missing prices, exit values and stock eligibility were resolved. If any gap remains, keep the study exploratory.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留带日期且不可覆盖的审计记录，逐项证明缺失价格、退出结算和股票资格问题已解决；只要仍有缺口，研究结论就维持探索阶段。

action.en-US: Compare matched stocks and years, estimate how uncertain the differences are, and check results by year and company size. These are retrospective diagnostics.
action.zh-CN: 在相同股票和年份上比较结果、估计差异的不确定性，并按年份和公司规模分组检查；这些都是回看历史数据的诊断。

acceptance.en-US: The recorded calculations and sample counts match the source files. Passing these checks does not show that the strategy can earn executable returns.
acceptance.zh-CN: 计算结果和样本数量与来源文件一致。通过这些检查仍不代表策略能产生实际可成交的收益。

action.en-US: Align explicit BSE suspension identities and preserve the original replay comparison.
action.zh-CN: 对齐北交所明确停牌的代码，保留与原回放的对照。

acceptance.en-US: Same-date events only; one diagnostic completes and nine advance. No quote imputation or assumed settlement.
acceptance.zh-CN: 仅连接同日事件，1 条诊断完成，9 条推进。缺价与未知结算均保留。

action.en-US: Run a separate common-start diagnostic from the first sufficiently covered growth month.
action.zh-CN: 按研发增长首次覆盖充分的月份运行独立共同起点诊断。

acceptance.en-US: 77 formations for all seven arms; growth has no missing formations but all ten growth sequences retain price gaps. Original twelve missing months remain missing.
acceptance.zh-CN: 七个变体均使用 77 个建仓月份。增长建仓完整，十条增长序列仍有价格缺口。原始缺失的十二个月继续保留。

action.en-US: Keep the prospective October 2026–September 2027 holdout sealed.
action.zh-CN: 继续封存 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月的前瞻留出。

acceptance.en-US: All registered labels must mature and independent evidence gates must pass before performance is read.
acceptance.zh-CN: 全部登记标签成熟、独立证据门槛通过后，才具备读取表现的资格。

diagnostic_note.en-US: These are retrospective comparisons of matched observations. For R&D, uncertainty is estimated by resampling 12-month blocks so nearby months can stay together. The ranges do not undo the fact that the idea was explored on historical data, restore missing report versions or remove market-wide time effects.
diagnostic_note.zh-CN: 这些是对齐样本后的历史比较。研发结果的不确定范围通过重抽连续 12 个月的区块估计，让相邻月份保留在一起。这样的范围不能消除事后探索的影响，不能补回缺失的财报版本，也不能排除市场整体随时间变化造成的影响。
